# run
# echo
# note the lower-case method, the unspaced header and the unindented body are
# note the file's own text, and rr fmt is what makes them canonical
>>> f.rr
what this file is for

-- sends the request as the file writes it --
post {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
content-type:application/json
content-length: 2

{"a":1}
>>> want f.rr
what this file is for
